rounds: Downloading films illegally isn’t really stealing.
Taking pens and paper home from the office is fine.
Using AI to write a university essay is cheating.
Returning clothes after wearing them once to a party is fine.
A company’s only job is to make money for its owners.
Ethical shopping is mostly a luxury for people with money.
I would work for a tobacco company for twice the salary.
Whistleblowers are heroes, even when they break the rules.
